propositions: The current per-criterion fan-out recovery design explodes token cost (440 requests worst-case for 22 criteria) and wall-clock time (sequential 25-90s per criterion) while discarding verified progress from failed primary runs.

Replace per-criterion fan-out with incremental criterion-banking at the CompletionAgentStep seam: criteria minted with deterministic IDs, verdicts recorded to a run-scoped bank as soon as verified, successor runs batch the unbanked remainder under a request budget pool.

Criteria-scaled primary step floor (verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(8*c, 48, 480)) reduces runaway-looping by giving low-criteria tickets proportional budgets rather than the flat 480, making typical tickets converge without recovery.
Path-normalized read_file memo collapses 77% re-read waste by caching whole-file content once and slicing all ranges from cache, eliminating redundant tool calls during verification.

Deterministic fallback ensures a run with banked progress never ends verdict-less: if the LLM finalizer fails twice, assemble the verdict directly from the bank (banked verdicts as-is, unbanked as met=false unverified placeholders) stamped certifiable=false.

Budget pool arithmetic (global = multiplier * ceil(floor/2), successor pool = global - primary spend) and batch-aware no-launch guard (shrink-replan when batch cannot launch) ensure successors complete with guaranteed progress or graceful degradation.
